comments.author: Morro
comments.body:
Got a quest sending me here:

A Place Where Heaven And Earth Are Turned Upside Down
Recognition 8 Geography 10 Arabic Language. 274,000 ducats
Portobelo Adventurers' Guild

-Speak to the Scholar in Istanbul x2
-Land at Black Sea Northeast Coast and go inland to Urstyurt Plateau
-Use Recognition near the Stacked Boulders in the northwest

Discovery is Tuzbair Salt Lake, 4 star Geography discovery. 720/360 exp

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
This area is accessible if you land at the Black Sea Northeast Coast landing point and click to go further inland via the Diagonal Boulder landmark at the far east point of the survey map. It's possible to go inland to this region despite a lack of a discovery (unlike older inland zones); land charting becomes possible after completing a total of 120 land charts. You may find the following here:

Trade goods (Procurement):
Onions (R2)
Red Beans (R2)
Olives (R3)
Wheat (R8)
Wetland Rice (R10)

Trade goods (Collection):
Hemp (R1)

Trade goods (any skill/rank; junk-type)
Rocks

Items (Search):
Kazakhs Hat (R11)
Traveller's notes
Adventurer's notes
Wood Spear
Telescope
Quadrant
Prospector's dowsing rod
Rusty short sword
Dull cutlass
Dull scimitar

NPCs:
Karim Gang Lv34 | drops Throwing Knife
Karim Gang Lv35 | drops Safflower
Karim Lv40 | drops Kazakhs Clothes and Surgeon's Secret Elixir

Weather/Phenomenon discovery: Mammatus Clouds (R5 Recognition required)

Cheers.

NPC source: www.ssjoy.org/dho/field/1518732
